title: Semitransparent organic and perovskite photovoltaics for agrivoltaic applications
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,37-54
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00492B, Review Article
Open Access

Souk Y. Kim, Noura Rayes, Armen R. Kemanian, Enrique D. Gomez, Nutifafa Y. Doumon
Combining agriculture and solar energy offers a promising solution for communities to support their food needs sustainably. Organic and perovskite semitransparent photovoltaics can be potential game changers in agrivoltaics applications.
